name: Home Assistant OS (ARM64)
description: Home Assistant OS built for ARM64 hosts running Pimox. The same appliance image as the amd64 VM, different architecture.

notes.text: Imports the preinstalled ARM64 HAOS appliance; no installer or Cloud-Init credentials are needed. After first boot, complete onboarding at http://<VM-IP>:8123. The console uses the native HAOS CLI.
